svg.aria-label: Am I Hacked? running in a PowerShell terminal with -Offline. It compares against a saved baseline and flags a new scheduled task and a new Defender exclusion, then scans accounts, defense evasion, the file system, network and processes. It finds a PowerShell connection to port 4444 and Word spawning PowerShell, and ends with the verdict COMPROMISED: 1 critical, 6 warnings, 5 info. Sample run with synthetic findings.
